mapper.select: select acc.id as memberId, acc.username as username, acc.email as email, mp.nickname as nickname from basket_member_account acc left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = acc.id and mp.is_delete = 0 where acc.is_delete = 0 and acc.account_status = 1 and acc.email is not null and trim(acc.email) <> '' order by acc.id asc

mapper.select: select id, notice_id as noticeId, member_id as memberId, username, nickname, email, send_status as sendStatus from basket_mail_notice_recipient where notice_id = #{noticeId} and send_status = 0 order by id asc
